name: robotopia.robotkit
description: Framework SDK service for spawning standard-agent robots that come up native (body, animation, native locomotion) and are driven by the game's own pathing, then overridden for behaviour and visuals. Also publishes a structured robot brain-query service, a multi-turn robot conversation service, a player dialogue-input service (typed text + push-to-talk voice via /agent/stt), and a robot objective service (persistent go-to/follow/patrol programs over named world targets) — the network services proxied through the game's own RoboAPI backend, mirroring how the base game lets you talk to robots.
